reason: My udhaar diary has worked for years and I trust it more than any phone. Free for 3 months is fine, but I would have to put every customer's old balance into it, and then I am paying 500 a month for something my diary already does.
objection: What happens after the free 3 months? If my khata is in their system and I stop paying, do I lose my records, or have I only made things harder for myself? I also do not know how it understands my customers' voice notes.
would_change_my_mind: A person from the company sits in my shop for a week and enters my diary into it. I keep the diary running alongside. I can take my full khata out whenever I want, and the price after 3 months stays well under 500.
